app.notes:
The remote is now one page, with what's playing, the queue, and the keypad together
Numbers pressed on the remote now appear on the app's screen
Donate to Mic-Key, and links to our Facebook Page and Group, are in Settings
Ocean Day is the new default theme
Countdowns now take one second per step, and you can choose to follow the beat instead
Light themes show white lyrics over videos, so they're easier to read
Updates now show what's new before you download
